summary.frozen_scope: Original 71 from the first enumeration, ending at session 20261112-092019 action index 56 (zero-based). The read-only corpus grew to at least 77 while analysis ran; later events are excluded.
summary.provenance: samples map requested t with bisect_left(frames.jsonl t), then decode video.mp4 by CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES=manifest i. The line field is the zero-based actions.jsonl row index, not a one-based text line number. All 71 source actions and 284 manifest sample records were matched exactly.
summary.method: All original 71 exact manifest-matched pairs and follow-up images reviewed; full-resolution targeted refinement is recorded per event. Parked/traffic context does not establish occupancy. Follow-up is one image eight seconds after the action segment ends, not continuous surveillance. Visible forced removal is recorded separately from later retaliation; a body beside a door alone does not establish previous occupancy.
